reference.method: Water/land control locations visually inspected against the municipal aerial image. These are shoreline checks, not vessel labels or surveyed positions.
reference.scope: St. John's harbour and immediate approaches only
reference.limitation: 2022 imagery cannot establish the current shoreline, tidal waterline, or accuracy between control locations. Coastal eligibility remains a separate policy.

rejected_candidate.reason: Initial hand-placed point lies at the quay/water edge, not clearly inside the basin. Excluded as ambiguous after overlay inspection; no polygon correction justified.
